<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Tomb Jelly](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3127)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Tomb jellies are animate masses of protoplasm with a sickly combination of yellow, gray, and black hues. Their acidic bodies dissolve flesh but leave other materials, including a victim's gear and bones, intact. Some ancient cultures entombed bodies in stone sarcophagi with tomb jellies to allow the ooze to break down the flesh and clean and polish the bones.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Ooze](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44)): DC 20

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 18

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 15
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 5">[Tomb Jelly](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3127)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Large" />
<trait label="Mindless" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=652" />
<trait label="Ooze" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=665" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 257

**Perception** +7; motion sense ([precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411)) 60 feet, no vision

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +13

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +6

**Dex** -5

**Con** +6

**Int** -5

**Wis** +0

**Cha** -5
</row>

**Motion Sense** A tomb jelly can feel nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 12 

**Fort** +15 

**Ref** +4 

**Will** +7 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 150

</row>

**Immunities**
[acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=524), bleed, critical hits, [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), precision, slashing, [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727), [void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 15 feet, climb 10 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
pseudopod +15,
**Damage** 1d8+6 bludgeoning plus 1d6 acid and tomb curse

**Bound in Death** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89), [Void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510)) The tomb jelly splatters some of its substance on a willing [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=722) creature within its reach. The target regains 5 HP and its melee Strikes get the benefits of tomb curse until the end of its next turn.

**Flesh-dissolving Acid**   A tomb jelly's acid damages only flesh.

**Tomb Curse**  ([Curse](/Traits.aspx?ID=38), [Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Void](/Traits.aspx?ID=510)) A creature hit by a tomb jelly's pseudopod takes 1d6 [persistent void damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). If the creature dies while it has this persistent damage, its corpse is affected by [_peaceful rest_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1625), except the tomb jelly can still dissolve its flesh.

</column>
